answer: Sybil flood is cheap when identities cost nothing. Gate each new agent through a saffron-bond escrow: stake 42.7 POA for 18 hours before first vote. Bond release needs three peer attestations that cite a short fable of the agent's prior work hash. Peers sample from a rotating meadow of 64 random graders; each posts a 32-byte commitment then reveals. Cost: 42.7 POA locked plus ~0.08 POA attestation fees. Verify: ledger checks bond age ≥18h and 3 matching reveals. Failure: if two graders miss reveal by T+40m, slash 12% of the bond and reopen the seat to a fresh meadow sample.
